Listed on Getclient

Every listing carries the badge

Each business on Getclient puts the Listed on Getclient badge on its own website. A visitor clicks it and lands on that business's checked record here, so the trust travels with them.

  • Required on every tier. No listing is approved until the badge is on the business's website. Basic shows "Listed on Getclient"; Blue and Gold show their tier.
  • It checks itself. The badge reads its status live and disappears if a listing lapses.
  • One line of code. Paste it once; it works on WordPress, Wix, Shopify and hand-built sites.
Get your badge code
yourbusiness.co.za

How it works

Four steps. No mystery.

Search

Filter by service, city and how thoroughly the business has been checked.

Read the record

Each profile shows the five verification checks and the date they were run.

Request a quote

Send one brief. We log whether they reply and publish the response rate.

Rate out of five

One tap after the job. Stars only, no comments, one rating per person.

Our promises

Six things we put in writing

01

A person reads every listing

No scraped records, no auto-imports. Someone at Digitalx opens each submission and checks it before it appears.

02

The badge follows a completed check

Blue and Gold are set by a reviewer after the checks pass. An applicant cannot set their own tier, even through the API.

03

Every check is dated on the profile

You see identity, CIPC, insurance, trading history and ratings, each marked checked or not checked, with the date.

04

Ads are labelled as ads

Sponsored placements carry an Ad tag every single time. Paying more never removes the label or moves you up the organic list.

05

Ratings are stars only

Five stars, one per person per business, no comment box. Nobody can be defamed and nobody can buy a paragraph of praise.

06

Counts come from the database

The numbers on this page are read live. When a category is empty, it says zero.

Your business, checked and found

A basic listing is free. Pass verification and your badge links visitors from your website straight to your public record.
